spans.s:
Ex. वीचीतरङ्गन्यायेन तदुत्पत्तिस्तु कीर्तिता। 

'Vīci' means a billow. When many billows come together, they develop into a Taranga (a wave). Due to wind, a billow develops into the shape of a wave. The maxim emphasizes the slowly developing billow into a wave. This is how the sound waves also develop and spread. -
